headerDisplay: Turns any device that exposes an HTTP API into a HomeKit accessory. Actions (`urls`) and mappers are edited in the JSON config.

service.title: Service
service.description: HomeKit service type, for example Switch, Lightbulb or TemperatureSensor.

optionCharacteristic.title: Optional characteristics
optionCharacteristic.description: Optional characteristics of the service to expose, for example Brightness.

setterDelay.title: Setter delay (ms)
setterDelay.description: Wait before sending a set request; only the last value is sent.

bearerToken.title: Bearer token
bearerToken.description: Literal token, env:NAME for an environment variable, or file:/path/to/token.

immediately.title: Send Basic credentials immediately
immediately.description: When off, credentials are sent only after the server answers 401.

props.title: Characteristic properties
props.description: Overrides of characteristic properties, keyed by characteristic name.

urls.title: Actions
urls.description: getXxx / setXxx actions. Edit them in the JSON config, see the README.
